hooks.logic:
Let currentParamSuffixNo be the current form of the enemy.
Let v2 be run helper2 on currentParamSuffixNo.
If currentParamSuffixNo is not v2, then
  The enemy changes to form v2.
  The enemy cancels its cast and stop.
If the enemy is ready to act, then
  Let ability be a smart-weighted move of the enemy.
  If ability is the id of the move labelled "offensive_maneuver" on the enemy, then
    Let bundle be call game:StatusAilmentsConfig.getBundle with (game:Conf.STATUS_AILMENTS_BUNDLE.ESNA).
    Let bundle2 be call game:StatusAilmentsConfig.getBundle with (game:Conf.STATUS_AILMENTS_BUNDLE.PARAM_BOOST_DISPEL).
    The enemy uses ability with its cast time followed by [{abilityId: the built-in move DEFORM_MULTI, abilityOptions: {sequence: [[{builtin: "UNSET_SA", sa: bundle, saChildNos: [1]}], [{builtin: "UNSET_SA", sa: bundle2, saChildNos: [1]}]]}}, {abilityId: ability}] and stop.
  The enemy uses ability.

flow.text: Let currentParamSuffixNo be the current form of the enemy.
Let v2 be run helper2 on currentParamSuffixNo.

yes.text: The enemy changes to form v2.

flow.text: the enemy is ready to act

yes.text: Let ability be a smart-weighted move of the enemy.
ability is the id of the move labelled "offensive_maneuver" on the enemy
Let bundle be call game:StatusAilmentsConfig.getBundle with (game:Conf.STATUS_AILMENTS_BUNDLE.ESNA).
Let bundle2 be call game:StatusAilmentsConfig.getBundle with (game:Conf.STATUS_AILMENTS_BUNDLE.PARAM_BOOST_DISPEL).

The enemy uses ability with its cast time followed by [{abilityId: the built-in move DEFORM_MULTI, abilityOptions: {sequence: [[{builtin: "UNSET_SA", sa: bundle, saChildNos: [1]}], [{builtin: "UNSET_SA", sa: bundle2, saChildNos: [1]}]]}}, {abilityId: ability}].

script_hooks.logic:
Given arg.
Let aiArg be the battle settings of the group of the enemy.
If arg's 'hpRateAiArg', then return the HP fraction of the enemy is at most the numeric entry arg's 'hpRateAiArg' in aiArg.
If arg's 'abilityTags' and condition flag v is up this frame, then
  Let v2 be the main move id of the last move of the enemy.
  Let ability be the id of the move labelled arg's 'abilityTags' on the enemy.
  Return ability contains v2.
Return false.

flow.text: Let aiArg be the battle settings of the group of the enemy.

yes.text: Return the HP fraction of the enemy is at most the numeric entry arg's 'hpRateAiArg' in aiArg.

flow.text: arg's 'abilityTags' and condition flag v is up this frame

yes.text: Let v2 be the main move id of the last move of the enemy.
Let ability be the id of the move labelled arg's 'abilityTags' on the enemy.

script_hooks.logic:
Given arg.
Let v2 be arg.
Let v3 be _ → find-where with (list, {paramSuffixNo: arg}).
If v3's 'changePhaseCondtions', then _ → any with (v3's 'changePhaseCondtions', given (x) { If run helper on x, then { Set v2 to x's 'nextParamSuffixNo'. Return true. } }, this state).
Return v2.

flow.text: Let v3 be _ → find-where with (list, {paramSuffixNo: arg}).

yes.text: _ → any with (v3's 'changePhaseCondtions', given (x) { If run helper on x, then { Set v2 to x's 'nextParamSuffixNo'. Return true. } }, this state).
